@@U01810@@
Service, organ and choir. 格蕾琴 in the midst of many people. The EVIL SPIRIT behind her.

@@U01812@@
How different it once was, 格蕾琴, when you came here to the altar, still full of innocence, and out of your little prayer book, well thumbed by generations, stammered your prayers, and in your heart half play, half God! 格蕾琴! What are you thinking? What crime is in your heart? Is it for your mother’s soul you're praying? Your mother who slipped sleeping into endless torment? Because of you? Whose blood is that on your doorstep? Yes, and beneath your heart is there something stirring, swelling, torturing you and itself with its foreboding presence?

@@U01814@@
Dear God! Dear God! Free me of the thoughts that attack me from every side in spite of myself!

@@U01818@@
(Organ music.)
translation:
@@U01810@@
服务、风琴和合唱团。 格蕾琴在很多人中间。她身后的邪灵。

@@U01812@@
格蕾琴，当你来到祭坛前，依然满怀纯真，从你几代人翻阅过的小祈祷书里，结结巴巴地念出你的祈祷文时，格蕾琴，你的心里一半是游戏，一半是上帝！ 格蕾琴！你在想什么？你心里有什么罪孽？你是在为你母亲的灵魂祈祷吗？你的母亲在睡梦中陷入无尽的折磨？因为有你？你家门口的血是谁的？是的，在你的内心深处有什么东西在搅动、膨胀、用它不祥的存在来折磨你和它自己？

@@U01814@@
亲爱的上帝！亲爱的上帝！让我摆脱那些不由自主地从四面八方攻击我的想法吧！

@@U01818@@
（管风琴音乐。）
